issues.explanation: In “又给一千兵,” 又 means “in addition/furthermore,” not “again,” which suggests repetition.
Here 给 means to give or provide troops to Liu Bei, not merely “to.”
In this context 卢植 was framed or falsely accused after refusing a bribe; “to entrap” gives the wrong sense.
Used adverbially before 出击, it means “suddenly,” not the adjective “sudden.”
